page.overview:
Who is Arin?

Arin was a female Duros who was once in a relationship with the criminal Cad Bane. While pregnant with her and Bane's child, she was shot in the crossfire of a duel between Bane and a city's marshal. Though she survived, married Bane's former friend—and the new marshal—Niro and eventually birthed her and Bane's son, Isaac, she eventually died some time later. As a result, Niro, who raised Isaac as his own, did so alone until Bane returned and killed Niro.

Arin first appeared in the "A Good Turn", an episode from the animated miniseries Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld, She was voiced by Dawn-Lyen Gardner.
